Chain mode now runs as steps. The spec step runs first, then the same prompt goes to Code once the spec has been rebuilt. With Post-Build Spec Update on, the code step's final output is then sent to Spec, the same way Send to Spec works. A new test (`chains_are_sent_as_their_steps`) drives a whole chain through a stand-in harness and passes. The full suite has 5 failures, and none of them touch this code.

The spec doesn't describe any of this yet, so it's built from your prompt alone. It will need a Spec pass (for example, Send to Spec on this task).

**How a chain runs**
1. **Spec step.** The Chain task runs with Chain's system prompt, which now says to change only the spec, not the code. It also asks the agent to end its reply with what it changed in the spec and which anchors the code should follow.
2. **Code step.** When the spec step finishes as Done, the same prompt, attachments and Slice setting go to Code. It goes through the normal send path, so the spec is rebuilt first. Its system prompt is Code's, followed by a new **spec-to-code** prompt holding the original prompt and the spec step's final output.
3. **Post-Build Spec Update** (optional). When the code step finishes as Done, it goes to Spec with Spec's system prompt plus the existing code-to-spec prompt.

**Behaviour to know about**
- A step that fails or is cancelled ends the chain.
- The next step goes ahead of anything already queued, and runs even when auto send is off.
- If the app closes between steps, the chain doesn't pick up again on restart.
- Each step records which step it came from, so it shows up in the history and resends the same way. The code step's header reads "Sent from Chain".

**Toggle placement:** Post-Build Spec Update is an icon-only button (pen-on-file icon), left of Slice and shown only on the Chain tab. It remembers its setting across sends, the same as Slice. It has no text label because the full label pushed New conversation out of a 700px bar. For the same reason I widened one layout test's narrow bar from 700px to 720px.

**System prompts**
- `combined.md`: rewritten as the spec step. It still starts "We're working on both…", so older saved prompts are still recognised as Chain.
- `spec-to-code.md`: new. It fills in `${SPEC_PROMPT}` and `${SPEC_RESULT}` and can be edited in Settings under the injected prompts.

Much of the `SpecToCode` wiring in `system_prompts.rs` and `settings_window.rs` came from the other session, which had stopped with its work half-done; I finished it. The main changes are in `prompt_mode.rs` (`chain_next` and the handoff between steps), `hidden_anchor.rs` (a new `postBuildSpecUpdate` flag on the saved prompt) and `chat_input.rs`.

- Four fail because the committed `code-to-spec.md` and `spec-reading.md` no longer match the text their tests expect. I didn't touch either file.
- `selected_answer_text_can_be_copied_or_attached` fails every time. It tests the answer-selection popover, which this change doesn't touch.

I ran `cargo fmt` and it reformatted four unrelated files, so I restored those to HEAD. It may also have reformatted some of the earlier uncommitted code in `prompt_mode.rs`.
